name: Deinonychus
printing: Revised v3.5 System Reference Document, original RTF archive
operationalEvidence: The original RTF and this summary use Large size and a 2d6 + 4 talon attack. The prose specifies one combined talon attack. The later Monster Manual errata table is a separate source.
appearanceEvidence: The SRD prose describes the green back and flanks, paler belly and dark spots or bars, stiff tail and about 600 lb. weight. Claws and stance follow the original portrait.
habitatEvidence: The printed Environment line gives warm forests.
separateSourceErrata: Wizards’ 17 February 2006 Monster Manual errata replaces the p. 60 table with a Medium creature. This entry follows the Large form in the assigned SRD archive. The d20srd.org display reflects the later table.

name: Cheetah
printing: Revised v3.5 System Reference Document, original RTF archive
operationalEvidence: The single Attack row omits the Bite’s damage. The matching Bite line under Full Attack supplies 1d6 + 3. Trip triggers on either natural attack, and Sprint is a charge-only ability.
appearanceEvidence: Editorial description of the existing portrait selected in the roster. Size and weight come from the printed prose.
habitatEvidence: The printed Environment line gives warm plains.

name: Giant Octopus
printing: Revised v3.5 System Reference Document, original RTF archive

appearanceEvidence: Editorial description of the existing portrait selected in the roster. The printed prose identifies arms at least 10 ft. long, barbs, and sharp-edged suckers.
habitatEvidence: The printed Environment line gives warm aquatic.
